frequency_question: How often do Union ministries successfully finalize and notify major industrial/transport subsidy schemes within a one-year planning window from initial public design phase?
membership_rule: Includes explicitly budgeted, centrally sponsored schemes targeting manufacturing or deployment of specific vehicle classes (e.g., FAME iterations, PLI schemes for automotive/EVs). Excludes general budget announcements without specific scheme guidelines or administrative notifications.

cases.name: Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Hybrid and Electric Vehicles (FAME I)
Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme for Automobile and Auto Component Industry
PLI Scheme for Advanced Chemistry Cell (ACC) Battery Storage

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 6 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 6 major relevant central automotive/EV schemes identified; all launched successfully upon political and ministerial prioritization.
known_gaps: Minor departmental sub-schemes or delayed proposals that were quietly shelved before formal drafting are difficult to comprehensively audit from base rates alone.
validity_reason: The institutional mechanisms and ministerial mandate for EV promotion in India remain stable under the current administrative framework.
